notes.title: UPDATE V0.1.0
notes.content:
As player feedback, we're trying to hone our mechanics further. We adjusted stamina, boss healths and player damage. Also some bugs are fixed. 


[b]SYSTEM CHANGES[/b]

[list]

[b]BOSSES[/b]

[*] Devil HP reduced by 20%
[*] Spider HP reduced by 20%
[*] Fire Golem HP reduced by 20%


[b]PLAYER[/b]

[*]Auto-attack attack speed has been increased.
[*] [i]NEW[/i] Now you can hold down Auto-Attack button to spam it!
[*] Auto-Attack damage has been increased from 20 to 30.
[*] Maximum stamina has been increased from 150 to 225.
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

[list]
[*] A bug where sometimes lamps disappear when play gets close to the wall has been fixed.
[*] A bug where player slide when staying on the stairs has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE V0.0.1
notes.content:
Edessa: School of Wizardry gets its first update!

In this update we've added the following:

[h2][b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b][/h2]

Now you can get up to six different achievements from playing Edessa: School of Wizardry. These are as follows:

[list]
[*] [i]Hidden[/i]
[*] [i]Hidden[/i]
[*] Rock To Pebbles
[*] House Cleaning
[*] De-evilization
[*] [i]Hidden[/i]
[/list]

You will need to find the '[i]Hidden[/i]' achievements by yourself!

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] A bug where traps can be seen where they were not supposed to be seen has been fixed.
[/list]
